look_here_first: Check the leaf node and raceme before anything else: A. humilis has a real 2–10 mm petiole and a tiny 0.7–0.9 cm axillary raceme. Those two measurements separate it quickly from the two sessile, long-racemed project species.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: low perennial or subshrub, stems erect or prostrate

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small alternate leaves, obovate to linear, margins entire

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: staminate petals free from the androphore

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: very small pistillate petals with flattened stigmas

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: seeds smooth to rugose or papillate

key_traits.label: Staminate flower
key_traits.text: Sepals 2.4–3.3 mm; petals 1.5–2.6 mm; (7–)10 stamens; 2–3 staminodes

key_traits.label: Pistillate flower
key_traits.text: Sepals 4–5.2 mm; styles 0.6–1.3 mm, glabrous; stigmas flattened

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Capsules 1.6–4.2 mm; seeds 1.5–2.5 mm, smooth to rugose/papillate

lookalikes.differences: Habit and pubescence vary too much for confident separation from A. aphoroides or A. simulans; prioritize inflorescence, flower, capsule, and seed characters.
